units: all energies and temperatures in units of D; momenta in units of 2pi/a
lattice: square, one transition-metal site (one orbital) per unit cell, spin-1/2 electrons; filling nu = n/2
dispersion: eps_k = -2 t (cos kx + cos ky) - 4 t' cos kx cos ky  (band width 8t = 7.9, van Hove at (1/2,0): eps = +4t')

t.from: band width in Fig.1(c),(d): 0.995+-0.003 and 0.984+-0.005; systematic from broadening model

t'.from: van Hove position in Fig.1(a),(c),(d): 0.198+-0.002, 0.192+-0.003, 0.194 (sign: vH above band centre)

U.from: separation of the two Hubbard bands in Fig.1(a): 12.023+-0.013 (stat.)

g.from: cutoff-free BCS gap equation with Delta(0.2)=1.967 (g=5.97) and Delta(0.3)=2.45 (g=6.25)

hamiltonian_coefficients.mu(nu=1/2): midgap, i.e. U/2 - 2t' above the atomic level

derived.Mott_bands: E_pm(k) = +-U/2 + eps_k/2 + c0, c0 = -(eps_min+eps_max)/4 = 0.39; compression 0.515+-0.03 (fit) ; weights (1 -+ eps_k/U)/2, slope (1.02+-0.07)/U
derived.Tstar_nu0.3: 3.5 +- 1 (gap closed at T>=4.4 in NMR, open below ~4 in resistivity)

resistivity.nu=0.2: rho=0 below Tc; above rho ~ T^(0.7-1)

pseudogap_state_nu0.3_parameters.meaning: A(k,w)=Z_k[p+ d(w-E_k)+p- d(w+E_k)], E_k=c+a eps+b eps^2, Z_k=u_k^2 of BCS(Delta1) on bare band, p+- = (1 +- xt_k/E_k)/2, xt_k = alpha+beta eps_k

numerics: k grids 700x700 (fits), 400x400 (final model), Gaussian instrumental broadening 0.10-0.19, Lorentzian eta=0.12 for ARPES maps, Kramers-Kronig on 16001-point frequency grid
